# three.js 0.160.0 (vendored)

The four files this app imports, copied unchanged from the npm package `three@0.160.0`
(https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.160.0.tgz, MIT licence in `LICENSE`). They are kept here so
that app sessions run offline and do not depend on a CDN answering in time (test-PC finding W3).

- `build/three.module.js`
- `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`
- `examples/jsm/webxr/VRButton.js`
- `examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js`
